data.title: R&D Director
data.summary: Lead hardware engineering and product execution from concept and prototyping through mass production. Guide technical teams and coordinate resources and cross-functional delivery for rugged outdoor hardware.

requirements.text: Builder mindset in an environment where little is fixed
requirements.question: What does 'builder mindset' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for a builder mindset without describing the behaviours or situations that demonstrate it.

requirements.text: Growth attitude and openness to personal and professional development
requirements.question: What does 'growth attitude' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting seeks a growth attitude but does not give a concrete example of how it is used in the role.

requirements.text: Hands-on approach, willingness to act and carry responsibility
requirements.question: What does 'hands-on approach' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests a hands-on approach without specifying the practical tasks or level of involvement expected.

requirements.text: Initiative, independent responsibility and delivery of results
requirements.question: What does 'independent responsibility' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises independent responsibility and results but leaves the expected scope of ownership open.

requirements.text: Broad technical understanding of mechanics and electronics
Record of owning outcomes and leading technical teams under pressure
Practical ability to use modern AI tools to improve R&D workflows
Relevant engineering and hardware product development experience
requirements.question: Would someone who has done engineering and hardware product development, with fewer than 15 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting sets a long minimum experience requirement for engineering and hardware product development.

requirements.text: Ability to work onsite weekly in Espoo, Finland

requirements.question: Is English needed from day one, or could someone start in Finnish and build up English on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires professional English fluency while explicitly stating that fluent Finnish is not required.
